statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
There is clinical concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities is required
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was to evaluate the underlying cause of syncope (R55)
The service was to ensure patient safety
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
